draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Following up on my last note — no pressure if things are busy on your end. Whenever you're ready, the first step is creating a real project; projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and I'm happy to walk it with you.

Would a short call this week work? I'll keep it to 15 minutes and we can get your first project set up together.

Best,
Chidi
